listing.name: Auto Outfitting
listing.aiSummary: Automatically outfits ships with optimal weapons and hull mods from available sources, including modded content.

description:
My mods are fully AI created mods that I created for my own playthroughs and have posted since I use them every time I play, and figured someone else may also find some use for them. If you use them and find any issues, stemming from either AI development wonkiness or just oversight on my part, let me know in the comments here or on github, either is fine, and I'll try to get things fixed quickly. The biggest advantage to slop is speed.

Auto Outfitting
"Optimal" autofit for Starsector 0.98a+0.98.5a.

This mod will automatically outfit your ships with the best available weapons and hull mods that you have to offer from either the station that you're docked at, what's in your inventory, or what's in the shops (including modded shops, modded weapons, and modded hull mods). It also has the ability to mod in S-mods and remove D-mods, give it enough money, and allow it to do so in the settings when you hit the button in-game (which you will see when you install it and you go to the refit screen).

There is also a button that allows you to order using all the blueprints that you have: a set of weapons for the fleet that you currently have, that is balanced and decent enough to do the job for what you have, and that tries to fill gaps with what you don't have currently available in your inventory.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and adds a settings menu (F3).
Updating: Delete the old folder in mods/ and extract the new one, or use TriOS.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Disclaimer
It's built on the numbers for every weapon, hull and ship I could find, from vanilla and my installed mods. It won't always beat a fit you build by hand. It's "optimal" because it balances your whole fleet in one go with almost no effort from you. It sure ain't perfect, lmao, but enjoy.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Forum post text: Mjolniar.
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: The mod icon is the Autarch AI Core portrait from Auto Colonies, made with Midjourney.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | Auto-er Pilot
